revoked.note: https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors — 401 'No valid API key provided'; https://docs.stripe.com/keys says an invalid key is an invalid request error

error.message: The provided key 'rk_test_****MOCK' does not have the required permissions for this endpoint.

forbidden.note: https://docs.stripe.com/api/errors — 403 'The API key doesn't have permissions'; the error type enum has no permission type, so invalid_request_error; message from observed responses

error.message: Too many requests hit the API too quickly. We recommend an exponential backoff of your requests.

rateLimit.note: https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits — 429 with Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason; code rate_limit per https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes. Stripe documents no Retry-After; the mock sends one anyway
